artworks.description: The image is a black and white engraving depicting a city divided by a river. The viewpoint is elevated, showing buildings on either side of the river. artworks.title: Sunlight Filtering through Trees along the River Sihl
artworks.artist: Conrad Gessner
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache on wove paper, laid down on board
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a view of a river winding through a lush green landscape. A cascade creates ripples in the river and trees with impressionistic brushstrokes form a canopy overhead. The color palette consists mainly of greens and browns, with hints of blue from the river. In the distance, several cattle stand in the water, and closer by, a figure walks with dogs along a sunlit path.

artworks.title: Kalaat-Esch-Schekif, Beaufort—Vue partielle de l'enceinte sud-ouest (Partial view of the south-west enclosure)
artworks.artist: Louis De Clercq
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert B. Menschel
artworks.description: The image shows a side view of a stone fortress wall on a rocky slope. Large stone blocks form the wall, which rises prominently from the ground near the left edge of the photo and extends towards the right. The horizon is not visible, as the view is focused on the structure against a featureless, pale sky. The wall is textured with closely arranged stone blocks, with scattered vegetation growing between them. The color palette is in sepia tones, giving it an antiquated, monochromatic effect. The scene emphasizes the detailed texture of the stone and rock.

artworks.title: Grand Temple d'Isis, a Philoe
artworks.artist: Maxime Du Camp
artworks.medium: salted paper print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert B. Menschel
artworks.description: The image shows a stone sculpture featuring ancient Egyptian figures carved in relief on the walls of a temple facade. Human figures with elaborate headpieces and garments are depicted in various poses on the wall surface. The structure is made of stone, possibly limestone or sandstone, with a natural, weathered tone ranging from light beige to gray. In front of the walls, the remains of columns with capitals are visible, supporting what seems to be a fallen roof or an entrance to the monument. The stone carvings are surrounded by a rugged terrain, suggesting an archaeological site. The scene is set against an open sky, emphasizing the scale and antiquity of the structure relative to modern viewers.

artworks.title: Eel Catcher's Home
artworks.artist: Peter Henry Emerson
artworks.medium: platinum print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert B. Menschel
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing on a small rowboat holding a large net on calm water. A weathered houseboat is seen to the right, with tall grasses and clouds in the background. The scene is in black and white, showcasing textures and reflections on the water.

artworks.title: The Horse in Motion
artworks.artist: Eadweard Muybridge
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert B. Menschel
artworks.description: This is a series of twelve prints showing a horse in different positions, arranged in three horizontal rows of four. The prints depict a horse and its rider as they move through a galloping stride. Each frame captures a different stage of the gallop. In all the prints, the horse and rider are black silhouettes with no detail. The backgrounds of the photographs are divided into numbered grids, providing a reference for the motion. At the bottom, below the last row of photographs, are several lines of text.

artworks.title: The Reverend Calvert Jones in the Cloisters at Lacock Abbey
artworks.artist: William Henry Fox Talbot
artworks.medium: salted paper print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert B. Menschel
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated under an archway, capturing their full body from a side angle. The person is sitting on some steps while slightly leaning back against a wall. They wear a dark hat, and a dark jacket over light-colored pants. Their facial features aren't distinctly visible due to the photograph's angle and lighting. They are positioned amidst an architectural structure, characterized by multiple arches covered in climbing ivy. Several windows can be seen above the arches. The ground around the structure is grassy. The scene is set in a sepia tone.
